newsitem.title: USA: Intraday CSCE world sugar higher but rangebound.
newsitem.headline: Intraday CSCE world sugar higher but rangebound.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures stood higher at midday amid light fund buying, but the benchmark October contract remained below its upside target.
The spot month tested Wednesday's low of 11.55 cents and held the key level, which attracted buying that carried the contract to the day's high of 11.68 cents.
At 1135 EDT, October stood 0.08 cent higher at 11.66 cents a lb, having ranged from 11.68 to 11.55 cents. The outer contracts were trading 0.06 to 0.08 cent higher.
An estimated 7,307 lots changed hands as of 1100 EDT.
A move below 11.55 cents is likely to attract substantial fund selling, traders said, pegging the next downside target at 11.40-11.20 cents."
Open interest in October fell by 704 lots to 112,280 lots as of early Wednesday.
